title: Ordinary sheaf comparison for locally fully faithful dense functors
statement:
Let $\mathcal C,\mathcal D$ be small categories, with Grothendieck topologies $J,K$: each topology contains the maximal sieve and is closed under pullback of covering sieves and transitivity; a sieve is a collection of arrows with fixed target closed under precomposition. Sizes are as in [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $p:\mathcal C\to\mathcal D$ be a functor. For a sieve $S$ on $C$, write $p_!S$ for the sieve on $p(C)$ generated by all $p(s)$ with $s\in S$. For $b:p(A)\to p(B)$, let $L_b$ be the sieve on $A$ of arrows $t:T\to A$ for which $b\,p(t)=p(c)$ for some $c:T\to B$. For $f,g:A\to B$ with $p(f)=p(g)$, let $E_{f,g}$ be the sieve on $A$ of arrows $t$ with $ft=gt$. Assume that the sieve generated by all arrows $p(C)\to D$ is $K$-covering for every $D$; that $p_!L_b$ and $p_!E_{f,g}$ are $K$-covering for every indicated $b,f,g$; and that $S\in J(C)$ if and only if $p_!S\in K(p(C))$.

Let $\mathcal A$ be a category admitting limits indexed by the opposite of each comma category $(p\downarrow D)$ (in particular $\mathcal A$ may be sets, abelian groups or modules over a fixed ring). An $\mathcal A$-valued sheaf is a presheaf for which every covering-sieve matching diagram is a limit diagram. Precomposition $L:\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal D,K;\mathcal A)\to\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal C,J;\mathcal A)$ is an equivalence. Its right adjoint $T$ has underlying presheaf the ordinary right Kan extension: $(TN)(D)=\lim_{(p(C)\to D)^{\mathrm{op}}}N(C)$. In particular this presheaf is a sheaf, and the adjunction maps $\mathrm{id}\to TL$ and $LT\to\mathrm{id}$ are natural isomorphisms. No full faithfulness of $p$ on the original hom-sets or fibre products of objects is assumed.
